impact.text: Later depositors buy worthless shares; their funds are effectively stolen.

precondition_sources.text: The HypoVault constructor pre-sets totalSupply to 1 000 000.
Before the first deposit is fulfilled, the vault owns zero underlying assets.

intent_sources.text: The vault should start with zero supply and mint shares only when assets exist.
